smooth_compact_white_test.scope: Numerical diagnostic on a genuine compact smooth unit bump, not a proof.

zero_covariance: All spatial energies and N1,N2^2 vanish; N0=theta^-2 remains.
wave_sign_check: xi=1,s=pi/2,t=3pi/2 gives product=-1; monotonicity cannot be applied to that product.
lambda_slice_check: theta=1,lambda=1,xi=1 gives the integrated time quadratic form3/20>0.
